metadata.name: dsh-effort-menu

paragraphs.text: Replaces the composer model menu with a recent-models list, an all-providers flyout, and a draggable
reasoning-effort slider.
# dsh-effort-menu
A replacement model menu for the DeepSeek Harness composer: pick a model and set its reasoning effor
t in the same popup.
English | 简体中文
In the shipped menu, effort lives in a submenu: after switching models, the "Effort" row opens a sec
ond list with Default, Low, High and Max. Following zcode's approach, this plugin puts the levels on
a slider at the bottom of the menu instead. The slider has one node per level the current model sup
ports, so the effort can be dragged right after picking a model.
The three most recent models sit at the top, and hovering the provider row opens every model in a fl
yout. Reads and writes go through the shipped per-session model directory, so the native selector an
d the `/model` popup share the same state.
## Screenshots
The model menu, with the reasoning-effort slider at the bottom.
| Light | Dark |
Hovering the provider row opens a flyout with every provider's models.
## Features
- The current level carries over on a model switch; if the new model lacks it, its highest level is

used.
- A model without its own default gets a leading "Default" node that leaves the choice to the

provider.
- A model list that fails to load is reported in the menu with a retry button.
- Keyboard

support. Arrow keys move between items and adjust the slider, `Esc` closes the menu.
- Follows the a
pp's light and dark themes; interface text in English and Chinese.
## Install
Requires DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` or newer, with a build that ships the `dsh-client-ui-conversation`, `dsh-c
lient-ui-model-selection` and `dsh-client-locale` client packages (see Compatibility).
### Web
With a CLI-managed profile, one command installs it into `web`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
There is no build step. The browser half is the committed `client.js`. Restart `dsh web`, or reload
no build step. The browser half is the committed `client.js`. Restart `dsh web`, or reload the page.
### Desktop
The `desktop` profile is managed by the app. Fully quit the app before using the CLI, or keep it run
ning and install the checkout directory through **Plugin Manager**.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the app after installing.
### Manual
If you would rather not use the CLI, edit the profile's own `package.json`.
**Web profile.** Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` and add the package to `dependencies`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then append it to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Run `pnpm install` in that directory and restart `dsh web`.
**Desktop profile.** Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` and add the same entry to `dependen
cies` only. The desktop profile does not list plugins in `bundles`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Run `pnpm install` and restart the app.
**Uninstall** with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-effort-menu`, or remove it in Plugin Manager
on the desktop app.
## Compatibility
- Supports DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` and newer. Developed and tested on DeepSeek Harness Desktop 44.7.0 (DSH

`0.2.2-rc.1`) on Windows 11; earlier DSH versions are not supported.
- The current model must expose
`reasoning.efforts` for the slider to have anything to show. Otherwise the menu says the model prov

ides no levels.
- Renders nothing in subagent sessions.
## Known limitations
- **One occupant of the model slot.** The plugin takes over the single slot `conversation.input.mode
l` at priority `-1`, shadowing the shipped selector. Another plugin that replaces the same slot comp
etes for it, so install only one. Plugins that restyle the shipped selector from outside may not app

ly to this menu.
- **The model label sub-slot is not extensible.** `conversation.input.model.label`
is declared by the shipped model-selection package, and a second declaration makes the whole client
entry fail to load. This plugin therefore renders model names itself, and labels that other plugins

contribute to that sub-slot do not appear here.
- **No automated tests yet.** Changes are checked by
hand in a running app.
